summary: A Health run's prd job hung and GitHub cancelled it at its 20-minute job timeout with no output, so nobody learned which probe hung: turbo-ci-run's own CI deadline (1200 s) could never fire first, because setup ate into the same 20 minutes. check.yml and deploy.yml already kept their timeouts above the deadline; health.yml now does too (a 25-minute step timeout inside a 30-minute job).
